## HBMAP Analysis Code (HPC)

```{r load_data}

EC8_new <- read.csv("ec_manuscript_data.csv", row.names = 1)

```


```{r}

# define target regions of interest
targets= c("PFC", "ORB", "MO", "ACA", "SS", "VIS", "PTL", "RSC")
R = length(targets)

# subset by target area + brain metadata column
ec_targets = ec_data %>% select(all_of(c(targets, "brain")))

# now we can convert to the standard hbmap input format
EC8_new = lapply(unique(ec_targets$brain), function(cat){
  t(ec_targets[ec_targets$brain==cat,1:R])
})

EC8_EC_label <- lapply(unique(ec_data$brain), function(cat){
  
  ec_data[ec_data$brain==cat,]$EC

})


C <- sapply(1:6, function(m) ncol(EC8_new[[m]]))
R <- 8
M <- 6

```

```{r}

#Initialize z

df <- lapply(1:M,function(m){
  normalized_mat <- apply(EC8_new[[m]], 2, function(col) col / max(col))})

df <- t(do.call(cbind, df))

cosine_normalize <- function(mat) {
  # Normalize each row by its magnitude
  return(mat / sqrt(rowSums(mat^2)))
}

df <- cosine_normalize(mat = df)


kmeans_result <- kmeans(df, centers = 40, iter.max = 100, nstart = 25)$cluster


C_cumsum <- c(0, cumsum(sapply(1:M, function(m) ncol(EC8_new[[m]]))))

clustinit <- lapply(1:M,
                    function(m) kmeans_result[(C_cumsum[m]+1):C_cumsum[m+1]])



```

```{r}

mcmc_all_EC8 <- mcmc_run_all(Y = EC8_new,
                             J = 80,
                             number_iter = 20000,
                             thinning = 5,
                             burn_in = 5000,
                             adaptive_prop = 0.0001,
                             print_Z = TRUE,
                             a_gamma = 30,
                             b_gamma = 1,
                             a_alpha = 1/5,
                             b_alpha = 1/2,
                             Z.init = clustinit)


```


```{r}

# Posterior similarity matrix
psm_EC8 = similarity_matrix(mcmc_run_all_output = mcmc_all_EC8)


```

```{r}

# Reordered posterior samples of z
EC8_z_reordered <- z_trace_updated(mcmc_run_all_output = mcmc_all_EC8)

# optimal clustering
EC8_Z <- opt.clustering.comb(z_trace = EC8_z_reordered,
                             post_similarity = psm_EC8,
                             max.k = max(k))

```


```{r}

# MCMC unique
mcmc_unique_EC8 <- mcmc_run_post(mcmc_run_all_output = mcmc_all_EC8,
                                 Z = EC8_Z,
                                 thinning = 5,
                                 burn_in = 5000,
                                 number_iter = 15000,
                                 Y = EC8_new,
                                 a_gamma = 30,
                                 b_gamma = 1,
                                 regions.name = rownames(EC8_new[[1]]),
                                 epsilon = 0.01)

```

## Save Results

```{r}

saveRDS(mcmc_unique_EC8, "ec_hbmap_results.rds")

```
